review_method: Assistant visual inspection via view_image, original upright image and preserved point overlays; no detector/segmentation inference or new labels
numeric_scope: All360 current frames; historical448 smoothing separately

observations.finding: Multiple right views show fitted elbow shifted distally on forearm, while 2D point and raw projection lie closer together. The shift is not explained by native/COCO mapping alone. Near hand, occlusion, extreme perspective and fisheye edge prevent direct localization of internal wrist center.

Fitted knee projections frequently sit below detector knee projections in both views; native and COCO projections are close. Dark loose pants conceal anatomical knee center, so this is model-observation disagreement rather than certified true knee error.

Model knee/ankle positions change more than raw knee triangulation; R/t held exactly. Original points also move, so frame320..322 is not claimed to be a static ground-truth pose. Body quality shifts sharply.
Background/viewpoint motion and some ankle localization changes are visible; raw geometry contains transients and real camera movement. Second differences cannot all be called noise.
Camera-space overlays plus exact R/t decomposition locate extra world-motion terms; image panels themselves contain no new ground render and do not certify correct Stage labels.
